source: Elsevier Scopus Search/Abstract Retrieval API (ISSN 0144-8617, -coverDate sort, 500-entry scan; all 8 unseen hits were Review/Editorial) + Crossref Works API (journals/0144-8617, from-created-date windows 2026-09-01~2026-10-20, primary discovery for very recent Articles-in-Press not yet indexed in Scopus) + PubMed E-utilities (supplementary cross-check over last 90 days, no additional new articles found beyond Crossref)
eligibility_filters: exclude microbe-biology-centric articles (strain/chassis development, fermentation condition optimization as core topic)
notes: Scopus Search API top ~500 entries sorted by -coverDate yielded only 8 entries not already in state/seen_articles.json, and all 8 were Review or Editorial subtype (confirmed via subtypeDescription), reflecting that daily runs keep the journal backlog nearly fully processed. Crossref from-created-date window scans (2026-10-13~2026-10-20, 2026-09-25~2026-10-13, 2026-09-01~2026-09-25) surfaced 20 candidate DOIs not yet in seen_articles.json; of these, 5 were judged to be review-pattern titles (broad multi-aspect subtitles such as "Sources, extraction, purification, and development" or "From X to Y"), matching the house style of titles independently confirmed as Review via Scopus subtypeDescription in the same window, and were excluded. One additional candidate (Bacillus thuringiensis exopolysaccharide gene-cluster/biofilm study) was excluded as microbe-biology-centric. This leaves 15 qualifying new research articles against the 20-article target; WebSearch supplementation for focus keywords (okara, soybean protein isolate, paper coating, biomass) found no additional qualifying articles in this window. Full abstract text was not accessible via Elsevier API, Crossref, or PubMed for any of the 15 articles (all are very recent Articles-in-Press, created in Crossref within the last 7 days); Korean descriptions were composed from title and bibliographic metadata only, per the no-abstract-available precedent of prior runs.
